$comment: Volume targets for the demo brain, v2 (2026-10-07, the owner's decisions on the demo refresh task): quality over quantity, 3 to 5 polished items per workspace, all in one story (world.json). 'target' is what the generator writes; 'min' is what verify.ts asserts after the seed. A seed below a min is a FAILED seed. The v1 volumes (about 760 nodes, 320 emails, 250 traces) are gone on purpose: they were filler, and filler is what made the old demo noisy.

page.notes: two team pages, the client revision family (rev A superseded by rev B), one private, one public; images from Files, link cards, mentions

note.notes: site visit report, data note, TQ-004, progress minutes, one private thought

file.notes: 20 illustrations (demo/world/art) + the issued procedure PDF, the I/O schedule XLSX and a private draft DOCX

table.notes: I/O schedule and load profile (team), snag list (client), budget (private), battery options (public); formulas, aggregates and saved views

formula.notes: pump specific energy (team), battery autonomy (client), pipe velocity (private)

app.notes: control room (client), loop check tracker (team), autonomy calculator (private); each built and published by the seed

task.notes: four open, one done; four due in the next ten days

event.notes: one past, three after seed time so the dashboard shows a future

contact.notes: exactly the world.json cast, owner included

documentation.notes: field guides, on disk, retrieval depth

recall.notes: three small native maps; two prompt cards in one of them

emails.notes: five threads, every sender in the cast

access.$comment: The four levels, asserted by verify.ts. Shared folders and their item counts are pinned by the generator (folders.mjs + gen.mjs expect); public items are the ones with an open link.

shared_folders.notes: a Team and a Client folder in each of the seven workspaces that can share

public_items.notes: a page (its two images go public with it), a table and a drawing, plus the two images

derived.$comment: Produced by the real ingest pipeline, never inserted. Floors only: they prove extraction ran on a small corpus, not a quality bar.

content_chunks.notes: every extracted node yields at least one chunk; pages and tables split

chunks_per_longform_node.notes: pages + tables must split, or passage retrieval has nothing to work with

entities.notes: the cast, the companies, PS3, the tags

behavioural.$comment: Produced only by the REAL chats run after the drain (turns.sh: four owner chats; seed-member-chat.ts: one member chat). Nothing else may generate traces, runs or audit rows: no filler.
